name: conductor
description: Orchestration for Claude Code and Codex. Conductor routes most lanes to Opus 5.5, keeps Fable 5.1 for critical review, critical design, high-stakes writing and escalation, and uses Codex (GPT-6 Sol at high as the default GPT model and routine cross-family reviewer, Astra for runtime verification, ops and critical review, Luna for high-volume items); Conductor Core is Codex-first with optional Opus 5.5 and no Fable dependency; Conductor Claude runs entirely on Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 when no Codex quota is available. All share explanatory reports and task-selected evidence.
